description.zh:
监控项名称。取值：

- nodeUsageStatistics：节点使用统计。

- nodeErrorDetails：节点错误明细。
description.en:
The metric name. Valid values:

- nodeUsageStatistics: node usage statistics.

- nodeErrorDetails: node error details.

description.zh:
监控项查询的扩展参数。当MetricName为nodeErrorDetails时，需传入一段JSON数据。JSON字段取值：

- pageNo：当前页数。

- pageSize：每页显示数量。

- nodeId：节点ID，在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面点击流程名称进入画布编排界面复制节点ID。
description.en:
The extended parameter for the metric query. When MetricName is set to nodeErrorDetails, pass in a JSON string. Valid values for the JSON fields:

- pageNo: the current page number.

- pageSize: the number of entries per page.

- nodeId: the node ID. On the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page, click the flow name to open the canvas and copy the node ID.

description.zh: 结束时刻。时间戳，单位：秒。
description.en: The end time. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

descriptions.zh:
- 在调用此接口前，请确保您创建的流程已上线且已触发流程。

- 若您的流程未上线，可在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击流程名称进入画布编排界面手动上线流程或通过[OnlineFlowVersion](~~2937203~~)接口上线流程。

- 触发器类型为手动的流程需要通过[TriggerChatFlow](~~2859101~~)接口触发流程或在[营销活动管理](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/MarketingActivityManagement)界面通过关联营销活动触发流程。

- 触发器类型为非手动的流程则无需手动触发流程，在对应绑定的商家账号给商家发送消息以后就会触发流程。
descriptions.en:
- Before calling this operation, make sure that the flow you created is online and has been triggered.

- If your flow is not online, go to the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page, click the flow name to open the canvas, and manually bring the flow online. Alternatively, call the [OnlineFlowVersion](~~2937203~~) operation to bring the flow online.

- For flows with a manual trigger type, call the [TriggerChatFlow](~~2859101~~) operation to trigger the flow, or go to the [Marketing Activity Management](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/MarketingActivityManagement) page and trigger the flow by associating it with a campaign.

- For flows with a non-manual trigger type, you do not need to manually trigger the flow. The flow is automatically triggered when a message is sent to the bound business account.
